note: Read by the Cash Hard Club app (Events tab) from https://cashhardclub.com/events.json. Newest first. Dates are ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. status: on-sale | free | announced | sold-out | postponed | cancelled | past. kind: event | drop. price = the exact per-ticket amount the buyer pays at checkout before tax, including every mandatory fee on whatever site the url opens; leave price out if unsure. Never use 0 (Free entry) if an RSVP or booking fee exists. age = e.g. "21+" exactly as the venue requires. access = only facts the venue confirmed in writing. url must be a store or approved ticketing link. Every fact printed on a flyer (date, time, venue, age limit, price) must also be in these text fields. No drink specials, alcohol brands or drinking imagery. Name a performer only after written confirmation.
